baseline.provenance: Recorded output of original baseline realism_diagnostics_v13.py; transient full log was lost when the execution environment reset. Only retained measurements are reproduced here.

notes: Paired normal intervals are descriptive sampling estimates, not benchmark pass/fail gates.
Benchmarks use synthetic populations, so match rates do not calibrate individual incidents.
The broad direct-red experiment is rejected: consistency is not validated recognition accuracy.
Conditional shot calibration can legitimately differ from situation-only xG because of finisher and keeper execution, the upper conversion ceiling, and sampling variation.
No real reference target is read by simulation. All declared seeds are retained.
